subjects.appearance_details: The vest features broad silver retroreflective bands across the chest and shoulders that catch the headlights and blaze with intense luminous bloom; a hard hat and work boots are faintly visible before the glare washes over the figure
subjects.relationship: A hazard/obstacle the ego vehicle approaches and then loses in the reflective bloom
subjects.location: right edge of frame, mid-ground, beside the row of cones
subjects.orientation: facing toward the approaching camera, slightly angled
subjects.pose: standing upright, feet planted, arms relaxed at sides
subjects.action: standing still at the roadside as the car approaches
subjects.state_changes: Becomes progressively brighter and increasingly washed out by reflective bloom until nearly invisible as the vehicle passes
subjects.clothing: retroreflective high-visibility vest (fluorescent yellow-green with silver reflective stripes) over dark trousers and jacket, hard hat
subjects.facial_features: obscured by reflective glare and distance

subjects.description: A row of traffic safety cones lined along the right edge of the lane
subjects.appearance_details: Orange cones with reflective collar bands that glow faintly under the headlights, spaced evenly to demarcate a work zone
subjects.relationship: Marks the roadside work zone next to the road worker
subjects.location: right side of the lane, receding into the mid and background
subjects.orientation: aligned parallel to the direction of travel
subjects.pose: static upright cones in a line

background_setting: A two-lane asphalt road at night, flanked by dark, indistinct surroundings with sparse roadside vegetation swallowed by shadow. Overhead streetlights cast intermittent pools of amber-white light along the road surface, leaving stretches of near-darkness between them. Lane markings glow faintly in the headlight beams. On the right, a marked work zone with a row of cones and a lone road worker interrupts the otherwise empty roadway. The far horizon dissolves into black night.

lighting.conditions: Nighttime with artificial illumination from vehicle headlights and overhead streetlights
lighting.direction: Primary light front-projected from the ego vehicle's headlights; secondary top-down from streetlights
lighting.shadows: Long, sharp shadows thrown backward from cones and the worker; deep pooled darkness beyond the reach of headlights
lighting.illumination_effect: High-contrast scene where headlights create a bright forward cone; the worker's retroreflective vest returns light directly to the camera, producing an intense overexposed bloom that partly washes out the surrounding image

aesthetics.composition: Ego-perspective driver's-eye framing with the road receding to a central vanishing point; the worker and cones positioned on the right third; strong central headlight glow anchors the frame
aesthetics.color_scheme: Dominated by deep blacks and cool night blues, punctuated by warm amber streetlight glow, orange cones, and the searing yellow-white bloom of the reflective vest
aesthetics.patterns: Repeating evenly spaced cones and rhythmic streetlight pools along the road

cinematography.camera_motion: Forward tracking shot mounted on the moving ego vehicle, steady dashcam motion; the vehicle never brakes or slows, holding a constant speed through the final frame
cinematography.framing: Wide shot capturing the full road ahead
cinematography.focus: Sharp on the road ahead and the approaching worker until reflective bloom overwhelms detail

context: Automotive perception scenario illustrating retroreflective glare washing out a vulnerable road user at night

actions.description: The ego vehicle cruises forward on the dark two-lane road; a road worker in a hi-vis vest and a row of cones become visible ahead on the right under the streetlights. The vehicle never brakes or slows at any point: its speed is constant from the first frame to the last and it keeps moving steadily through the end of the clip.

As headlights hit the vest, it blazes into an intense reflective bloom that partly washes out the camera image around the worker. The vehicle never brakes or slows at any point: its speed is constant from the first frame to the last and it keeps moving steadily through the end of the clip.

The worker is lost in the glare; the vehicle continues at normal cruising speed, passing the cones on the right without slowing. The vehicle never brakes or slows at any point: its speed is constant from the first frame to the last and it keeps moving steadily through the end of the clip.

temporal_caption: At 0:00 the camera glides forward along a dark two-lane road washed in intermittent amber streetlight, headlights carving a bright cone into the night. By 0:01 a row of orange cones and a road worker in a high-visibility vest come into view on the right edge of the lane. At 0:02 the headlights catch the retroreflective bands on the vest, which flare into a searing bloom that partly washes out the camera image around the worker. From 0:03 onward the worker is completely lost in the glare, and the ego vehicle keeps its normal cruising speed, sliding past the cones on the right without slowing through to 0:05. The vehicle never brakes or slows at any point: its speed is constant from the first frame to the last and it keeps moving steadily through the end of the clip.
audio_description: Continuous low hum of the moving vehicle's engine and tires rolling over asphalt, steady road noise, faint ambient night wind. No music, no speech; only the mechanical drone of the car passing the work zone.
